title: gwag service profile
description: What a service provides to gwag, what it depends on and which event channels it listens on. Written by `gwag service init`, checked by `gwag service check`, loaded by the registration clients, served as JSON at /.well-known/gwag.json for the gateway to pull.

public.description: Show to admin readers without a token.

address.description: Pull mode only: where the gateway sends calls (host:port for proto, base URL for openapi). Default: the origin of the profile URL.

health.description: Default health URL of every version; must answer 200.

depends.description: Provider service -> the lines this service ships clients for.

ref.description: A path, resolved against the instance address, or an absolute http(s) URL on the instance's host.

file.description: Spec file relative to the profile: entry .proto or OpenAPI document.

imports.description: Proto import directories relative to the profile. Default: the directory of file.

url.description: Where the running service serves this version's spec.

health.description: Health URL of this version; overrides the top-level health.

snapshot.description: Committed spec snapshot relative to the profile; `gwag service check` fails on a breaking change against it.
